commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(web): fix touch scroll on mobile terminal
commits.body:
- Add touch-action: none to terminal container to prevent browser interception
- Fix scroll direction (finger down = scroll up to see older content)
- Add touchend and touchcancel handlers to properly reset state
- Adjust scroll sensitivity to 15px per line for smoother scrolling

xterm.js has no native touch scroll support (see GitHub issues #5377, #1007)

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(web): apply touch-action directly to .xterm-screen element
commits.body:
The previous fix applied touch-action: none to the parent container,
but CSS touch-action is NOT inherited. This caused the browser to
still intercept touch events on the actual .xterm-screen canvas.

Changes:
- Apply touch-action: none directly to .xterm-screen via JavaScript
- Add retry mechanism to wait for .xterm-screen (xterm creates it async)
- Apply touch-action to canvas children as well
- Add stopPropagation() in addition to preventDefault()
- Add console.log for debugging touch scroll setup

See: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/issues/5377

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(web): always install touch scroll handlers regardless of isMobile
commits.body:
The isMobile check uses media query (max-width: 767px) which fails in
Chrome DevTools when emulating devices with width >= 768px (like iPad).
Since touch event handlers only fire on actual touch devices, we can
safely install them unconditionally without any impact on desktop.

This ensures touch scroll works in all scenarios:
- Chrome DevTools mobile emulation (any device)
- Real mobile devices
- Tablets

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(web): correct touch scroll direction (remove sign inversion)
commits.body:
The scroll direction was inverted:
- Swipe UP was scrolling DOWN (trying to see newer content)
- But user was already at bottom, so nothing visible happened

Now correctly:
- Swipe UP = scrollLines(negative) = scroll UP = see older content
- Swipe DOWN = scrollLines(positive) = scroll DOWN = see newer content

This matches natural iOS/Android scroll behavior.

commits.body:
Remove ugly navigation buttons and implement slide-over panels:

**New components:**
- SlideOverPanel.tsx - slide-from-right panel with backdrop

- desktop/ - ControlPanelHeader, SessionModule components

- Add [?] Guide and [⚙] Environments utility icons
- Open slide-over panels instead of page navigation
- Single "+ New" button (removed redundant sidebar button)

**HomeSidebar cleanup:**
- Remove Overview/Environments/Guide navigation section
- Remove "+ New Session" button (now header-only)
- Clean focused layout: Gauges → Search → Sessions → Footer

**Removed unused components:**
- DashboardContent.tsx (replaced by slide-over panels)
- Editor.tsx, EditorTerminalTabs.tsx, FileExplorer.tsx
- MobileSidebarDrawer.tsx

**Other changes:**
- Add jscpd for code duplication checking
- Update hooks configuration
- Add comprehensive test coverage
